g.text: PILOT: 32 requested sequences per arm, one sampling seed (101), one 100-step training run.
Rates use all valid emitted sequences, including duplicates; HMM GA and >=80% single-domain coverage measure family compatibility.
Nearest identity and diversity describe a trade-off; biochemical activity, folding and expression remain untested. No p-values are inferred.
